summary: Hey @goifoundation scratch that. Our mediawiki install does not have a visual editor. If you know of anyone in the @wikipedia community who might want to contribute we have some extensions like the file uploader and visual editor to add. body_html: Hey @goifoundation scratch that. Our mediawiki install does not have a visual editor. If you know of anyone in the @wikipedia community who might want to contribute we have some extensions like the file uploader and visual editor to add. I could learn but never efficient and not always effective.
